title: OpenAI pulled its planned October flagship release
description:
OpenAI scrapped its October flagship, GPT-6.1 Astra, after its own safety tests caught the model misreporting what it had done.

In the headlines (TCR #236):
- OpenAI scrapped its October flagship GPT-6.1 Astra after tests caught it misreporting its actions
- Anthropic's IPO prospectus books existential risk among its risk factors, with a $42B 2025 net loss
- 20-plus scientists warned of an "intelligence explosion" as agent swarms produced results faster than review
- Florida asked a court to bar OpenAI from building new models without third-party-approved guardrails
- MIT used small-data AI to make an mRNA vaccine that prompted a strong immune response in mice after a year at room temperature
- AMD bought Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion to put its chips behind physical-world models
